nodes.npcLine: 👨‍💼 Look how far you have come! Do you remember when you first arrived at COSY Town in Chapter 1?

playerOptions.text: 🔑 Yes! You showed me Headquarters and helped me open my apartment!

nodes.npcLine: 🏆 Exactly! From introducing yourself to mastering shopping, directions, dining, and future travel plans — you are now a Citizen of the World!

playerOptions.text: 🌍 Thank you, James! I am ready to explore the world!
